question: Under recorded viewing conditions, do observers report visible temporal instability or a stability difference among the three B25 holdout sequences?

playbackCarrier.acceptance: Decode all 144 frames back to RGB and require 144/144 exact pixels, maximum error 0, zero changed pixels; alpha may be omitted only after verifying every source alpha sample is opaque.

observerDesign.balanceAtTarget: each of the six A/B/C order permutations is assigned to exactly three observers

blinding.mappingCommitment: SHA-256 over canonical session schedule plus a 32-byte random salt
blinding.sealedMappingLocation: ignored local work directory, excluded from published package and observer interface

required: player or browser name and version

decisionRule.INTERFACE_PILOT_ONLY: One or more developer/owner sessions validate the package interface but cannot contribute to formal perception claims.
decisionRule.INFORMAL_REVIEW_ONLY: At least one but fewer than 15 valid independent observers complete the protocol; publish responses descriptively without a formal visibility conclusion.
decisionRule.FORMAL_REVIEW_INCOMPLETE: 15-17 valid independent observers complete the protocol; preserve results and recruit to the balanced target of 18 before a production gate decision.
decisionRule.NO_DIFFERENCE_OBSERVED_UNDER_TEST_CONDIT: All 18 valid observers rate every clip NONE or BARELY_VISIBLE and choose INDISTINGUISHABLE for all three pairs.
decisionRule.VISIBLE_TEMPORAL_DIFFERENCE_SUPPORT: At least two valid independent observers identify the same clip/time region as MILD or worse, or choose the same directional pair preference with an overlapping time/location note.
decisionRule.OBSERVER_DISAGREEMENT: The 18-observer target is complete but neither formal outcome rule is met.
decisionRule.INVALID_REVIEW: Any carrier, identity, schedule, blinding, response-lock, viewing-record or validity gate fails.

requiredNegativeCases: source alpha is not fully opaque
carrier RGB roundtrip differs by any pixel
sealed mapping exposed to observer package
human conclusion emitted below the valid-observer gate
explicitNonClaims: An automated metric or carrier roundtrip pass is not a human visibility result.
A developer/owner pilot can validate only the interface and recording workflow.
Even a formal pass applies only to this six-second proxy, tested displays, viewing conditions and observer sample.
The protocol does not validate scene-linear EXR masters, motion blur, 4K cinema projection, another scene or another render engine.
Absence of reported difference is not proof that no difference exists.
The study evaluates temporal stability differences, not acting, composition, narrative quality or overall cinematic merit.
